front: Why a mask alone does not save compute
back: The kernel must skip masked blocks (FlashAttention/FlexAttention block sparsity); a dense kernel still computes them.

front: Which KV head does query head j use in GQA?

back: Cache a low-rank latent $c_t$ (rank $r$); reconstruct K and V per head with up-projections, absorbable into the query/output matrices.

front: DeepSeek-V3 128K cache: MLA vs GQA baseline
back: 7.625 GiB (r=512, 61 layers) vs 30.5 GiB (8 KV heads, d=128): 4x smaller, before the small rotary key.

front: Effect of a sliding window on the cache
back: Each window layer keeps only $\min(N,W)$ tokens, so the cache stops growing with context.
Softmax rows must sum to 1, so queries with nothing to attend to dump weight on early tokens; differential attention reduces this.
